name: Rita Loud
source:
To hear them tell the story, it was my Mom who went after my [url=https://vndb.org/c151406]Dad[/url], and considering how much of a dork he is, we almost find it hard to believe! When you look at my sisters and see how beautiful and talented they all are, it's clear they get it from our Mom. My Mom is awesome, she's beautiful, talented, tough, intelligent, and sweet. She knows how to repair cars, fly planes, drive tanks, and run a household full of 11 kids!

She works as a Dental assistant but has dreams of being a novelist, and likes to write stories in her spare time. It's my opinion she's the best Mom ever! 

Mom is there with her own brand of wisdom, kindness, and patience when we need it. All my sisters are Daddy's girls in their own way, and I guess that makes [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]me[/url] something of a Momma's boy. Whenever I have a problem, or need advice, I know my Mom will be there for me.

I'll say one thing though, my Mom has to be crazy about my Dad. I don't like to think about it too much, but given they have 11 of us, the two can't keep their hands off one another!

[In game description]
